    # reconstruct background (maroon + grey bars)

    # isolate the puppet by finding the CC that has orange hair
    comps = find_connected_components(input_grid, background=Color.MAROON, monochromatic=False)
    puppet_cc = [c for c in comps if (c == Color.ORANGE).any()][0]
    x0,y0 = object_position(puppet_cc, background=Color.MAROON)
    sprite = crop(puppet_cc, background=Color.BLACK)
    sh,sw = sprite.shape
    # find arm pixels and mouth pixel in sprite coords
    arms = [(i,j) for i in range(sh) for j in range(sw) if sprite[i,j] == Color.YELLOW]
    mouth_pos = next((i,j) for i in range(sh) for j in range(sw) if sprite[i,j] == Color.RED)
    # replicate input three times side by side
    out = np.tile(input_grid, (1,3))
    # frame 2: arms up 2
    for i,j in arms:
        out[x0+i-2, y0+j + w] = Color.YELLOW
        out[x0+i,   y0+j + w] = background[x0+i, y0+j]
    # frame 3: arms up 4
    for i,j in arms:
        out[x0+i-4, y0+j + 2*w] = Color.YELLOW
        out[x0+i,   y0+j + 2*w] = background[x0+i, y0+j]
    # enlarge mouth in frame 3 by one pixel row under it
    mi,mj = mouth_pos
    out[x0+mi+1, y0+mj + 2*w] = Color.RED
    # overlay text "I'M FREEEE" in pink above the head in frame 3
    text = "I'MFREEEE"
    tlen = len(text)
    start = y0 + (sw - tlen)//2 + 2*w
    header = x0 - 1
    for dj in range(tlen): out[header, start+dj] = Color.PINK
    return out

from common import *
import numpy as np
import random

def main(input_grid):
    # replicate input three times side by side
    h, w = input_grid.shape
    out = np.tile(input_grid, (1, 3))
    # find the puppet component (it has ORANGE hair)
    comps = find_connected_components(input_grid, background=Color.BLACK, monochromatic=False)
    puppet = next(c for c in comps if np.any(c == Color.ORANGE))
    sprite = crop(puppet, background=Color.BLACK)
    x0, y0 = object_position(puppet, background=Color.BLACK)
    # for middle and right frames, shift arms up and enlarge mouth
    for frame, raise_amt in [(1, 2), (2, 4)]:
        dx = y0 + frame * w
        # draw all non-black pixels of sprite, except arms get moved up
        for i, j in zip(*np.where(sprite != Color.BLACK)):
            col = sprite[i, j]
            if col == Color.YELLOW:
                out[x0 + i - raise_amt, dx + j] = col
            else:
                out[x0 + i,     dx + j] = col
        # in third frame enlarge the mouth by one red pixel below the original mouth
        if frame == 2:
            mouth_y = np.where(sprite == Color.RED)[1][0]
            mouth_x = np.where(sprite == Color.RED)[0][0]
            out[x0 + mouth_x + 1, dx + mouth_y] = Color.RED
            # overlay a white bar as a stand-in for text just above the head
            for j in range(sprite.shape[1]):
                out[x0 - 1, dx + j] = Color.GREY
    return out

def generate_input():
    # random grid size up to 30x30
    H = random.randint(15, 30)
    W = random.randint(15, 30)
    grid = np.full((H, W), Color.BLACK)
    # draw random vertical metallic bars
    for x in range(0, W, random.randint(3, 6)):
        draw_line(grid, x, 0, direction=(0, 1), color=Color.MAROON)
    # define a small fixed puppet sprite
    sprite = np.array([
        [O := Color.ORANGE]*5,
        [O, O, Color.BLACK, O, O],
        [Color.BLACK, Color.GREY, Color.BLACK, Color.GREY, Color.BLACK],
        [Color.BLACK, Color.BLACK, Color.RED, Color.BLACK, Color.BLACK],
        [Color.BLACK, Color.YELLOW, Color.YELLOW, Color.YELLOW, Color.BLACK],
        [Color.YELLOW, Color.BLACK, Color.BLACK, Color.BLACK, Color.YELLOW],
        [Color.BLACK]*5
    ], dtype=object)
    # place sprite at a random free location
    x, y = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, sprite, background=Color.BLACK, padding=1)
    blit_sprite(grid, sprite, x=x, y=y, background=Color.BLACK)
    return grid

Description: 
In the input you will see a single orange-haired puppet (bulging white eyes, open mouth) with its yellow-orange arms hanging down against a blurred brown-metallic barred background. There is no text in the input. The puppet’s facial features and background bars remain static. To make the output: 1. Detect and isolate the puppet sprite (hair, eyes, mouth, torso, arms) on the non-black background. 2. Create three side-by-side “frames” by replicating the entire input grid horizontally three times. 3. In the first (leftmost) frame, leave the puppet exactly as in the input (arms down). 4. In the second (middle) frame, raise the puppet’s arms by moving every arm pixel up by 2 cells, preserving arm shape and color. 5. In the third (rightmost) frame, raise the arms a further 2 pixels (total of 4 up), and slightly enlarge the mouth by adding one pixel row to the lower lip. 6. Overlay bold white uppercase text “I’M FREEEE” centered just above the puppet’s head only in the third frame. 7. Keep the background bars and all original colors unchanged behind each puppet copy.
